requests.name: truth-washington-faithful
requests.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction, identity-preserve.
Asset type: identity-faithful full-body photographic cutout for an existing cast website.
Edit target: Image 1 is the ORIGINAL full-body Truth Washington photograph. Image 2 is the ORIGINAL close facial reference of exactly the same man. The face in Image 2 must govern facial likeness. This is a faithful photo restoration and background removal, not a reimagined person.
Primary request: reproduce the original man from head to shoes on a genuinely transparent background, portrait canvas 1024x1536. Preserve his original anatomical proportions, exact stance, position of hands, straight-on body orientation, clothing, jewelry, and neutral serious expression. His right arm (image left) rests straight down; his left hand (image right) is tucked into his trouser pocket beside the watch. Include full scalp, both hands as originally visible, and complete white shoes with a small transparent margin all around.
Identity lock: preserve the original specific face, bald scalp shape, head proportions, broad brow and its creases, eye shape and spacing, flat neutral lips, nose shape, jaw width, subtle mustache and small neat goatee, and medium brown skin tone. Use the close-up as a literal likeness guide. Do not age, masculinize, beautify, caricature, slim, or generalize the face. No smile, no new expression.
Preserve exact wardrobe: black knit crewneck sweater, original two fine silver necklaces with small pendant, dark black distressed biker jeans, original metal watch at image-right wrist, white low-top shoes. Preserve natural skin and fabric texture.
Background: true alpha transparency, no gray backdrop, no checkered pattern, no floor, no horizon, no cast shadow detached from the person, no room, no pedestal. No text or logos. Clean realistic edge extraction; no glow, no halo. Do not crop or change the pose.

requests.name: reception-truth-jen-seated
requests.prompt:
Use case: compositing, identity-preserve.
Asset type: finished photorealistic cinematic reception-room photograph, wide website background.
Input images: Image 1 is the reception room EDIT TARGET. Images 2 and 3 are the original full-body and close-up identity references for Truth Washington. Images 4 and 5 are the original full-body and close-up identity references for Jen Sparx.
Primary request: EDIT the existing reception photo to place Truth and Jen sitting naturally IN the existing orange foreground lounge seats on the RIGHT HALF of the room, as integral photographed inhabitants of the room. Remove only the two standing strangers at the left entrance and realistically reconstruct that room background. Leave the left approximately 45% quiet and empty of people so the actual website can overlay copy there.
Preserve: the same room, fixed wide camera position, lens and perspective, entrance and window grid, sunset outside, dark blue and warm bronze ambience, wood slats, reception desk and its attendant, plants, floor reflections, marble coffee table and books, foreground seating, central orange armchair, right orange seat, architectural proportions, ceiling strip lighting. Preserve the wall logo shape and wording RTV / AI STUDIOS and the arrow as faithfully as possible. The original room is the composition template, not merely style inspiration.
Truth Washington: place him seated normally in the EXISTING central orange armchair at about 65% of image width. His hips rest on the chair cushion and his back is supported by the chair back; his knees bend naturally, and white-shoed feet are down near the floor with plausible table occlusion. The chair arms overlap parts of his body exactly as real furniture would. Keep realistic adult scale relative to the chair and reception desk. Wear his reference black sweater, two silver necklaces, dark jeans, white low-top shoes, and metal wristwatch. Lock his face to reference Image 3: same bald head, facial proportions, brow, eye spacing, nose, neutral lips, jaw, subtle mustache and goatee, skin tone, and age; no smile or invented older face.
Jen Sparx: seated comfortably in the EXISTING orange seat on the far right at about 88% width, hips and back physically supported, correct bent knees and furniture occlusion, relaxed conversational orientation slightly toward Truth. Her long blond braids, face, eye color, skin tone, reference orange blouse, black knee-length pencil skirt, and black heels remain consistent with Images 4 and 5. Preserve her expression and identity without beautifying or redesigning her.
Photographic integration: both people are normal human scale, naturally lit by warm room lights and cool window light; physical contact, contact shadows, soft reflected light, furniture occlusion, lens perspective, and grain all match the room. Keep their bodies behind and around the table as perspective requires. This must read as one real photograph.
Framing: retain room-wide 16:9 composition, requested 2048x1152 or higher, no crop toward faces, no giant foreground portraits, no standing people, no pasted standing cutouts, no floating bodies, no additional chairs, no duplicate people, no page UI, headlines, buttons, or overlaid text. Keep image left quiet and the two seated subjects entirely on the right half.
